affidavit.notes: Indian Stamp Act Schedule I, Article 4, as applied in Lakshadweep.

mortgage.notes: Without possession: 0.5%. With possession: full conveyance rate.

gift.notes: Blood relatives concessional; non-family at near sale-deed rate.

verification.source: Court Fees Act 1870 (Lakshadweep)

courtFee.notes: Tamil Nadu Court Fees and Suits Valuation Act 1955 as applied in Puducherry (shared judicial lineage with TN). No statutory cap on ad-valorem; advocates verify with the local district court schedule.

saleDeed.notes: Plus 4% registration fee - total ~11%, mirroring Tamil Nadu's combined burden.

lease.notes: Lease under 30y: 1% of total rent + premium. Above 30y treated as conveyance.

powerOfAttorney.notes: GPA without consideration. Family PoA attracts a nominal fixed fee with reduced registration fee.

affidavit.notes: Indian Stamp Act Schedule I-A, Article 4, as applied in Puducherry.

mortgage.notes: Simple mortgage: 1%. With possession: 4%.

gift.notes: To family member: concessional rate. Others: full conveyance rate.

verification.source: Tamil Nadu Court Fees and Suits Valuation Act 1955 (as applied in Puducherry)
